conventions.directional_recall: mean recall of the four non-stable classes
conventions.qwk: quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa over the ordered five classes
conventions.bootstrap: paired_cluster_bootstrap_counts, 2,000 draws, each round's frozen seed

class_weight_ratio_to_stable.note: CE weight of each class divided by the stable weight; balanced weights are N/(5 n_c), so the ratio is n_stable / n_c
